intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «ものの» admits a fact and contrasts it with a limited or unexpected result.
texto: It's common in writing and careful speech. Read the second part to identify which expectation isn't met.
新しい 制度 を 導入 した ものの、利用者 の 数 は まだ 増えて いません。 (Although a new system was introduced, the number of users still hasn't increased.)
必要 な 機能 は そろった ものの、操作 に 慣れる まで 時間 が かかります。 (Although the necessary functions are all in place, it takes time to get used to operating them.)
